mapper.sql: select a.id, a.bill_no, a.warehouse_id, w.name as warehouse_name, a.bill_date, a.total_amount, a.scrap_reason, a.bill_status, a.audit_by, a.audit_date, a.remark, a.del_flag, a.tenant_id, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, coalesce(nullif(trim(cu.nick_name), ''), cu.user_name) as create_by_name, coalesce(nullif(trim(au.nick_name), ''), au.user_name) as audit_by_name from stk_scrap_bill a left join fd_warehouse w on a.warehouse_id = w.id left join sys_user cu on cu.user_id = ( case when a.create_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.create_by as unsigned) else null end ) left join sys_user au on au.user_id = ( case when a.audit_by regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(a.audit_by as unsigned) else null end )
mapper.select:
(a.del_flag = '0' or a.del_flag is null) and a.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId}
and a.bill_no like concat('%', #{billNo}, '%')
and a.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}
and a.bill_status = #{billStatus}
and a.scrap_reason like concat('%', #{scrapReason}, '%')
and coalesce(nullif(trim(cu.nick_name), ''), cu.user_name) like concat('%', #{createByName}, '%')
and a.audit_date is not null and date_format(a.audit_date, '%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginDate}, '%Y%m%d')
and a.bill_date is not null and date_format(a.bill_date, '%Y%m%d') >= date_format(#{beginDate}, '%Y%m%d')
and a.audit_date is not null and date_format(a.audit_date, '%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d')
and a.bill_date is not null and date_format(a.bill_date, '%Y%m%d') <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y%m%d')
order by a.create_time desc, a.id desc

select id, parent_id, bill_no, line_no, inventory_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, speci, model, unit_name, qty, price, amount, batch_no, produce_date, expiry_date, manufacturer, remark, del_flag, tenant_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from stk_scrap_bill_entry where parent_id = #{parentId} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null) order by line_no asc, id asc
mapper.update: update stk_scrap_bill set bill_status = #{billStatus}, audit_by = #{auditBy}, audit_date = #{auditDate}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (del_flag = '0' or del_flag is null)
mapper.insert:
